card.name: Forge reporter
card.purpose: Raises a ticket that lists what was finished in a Jira project.
good_for: Raise a ticket listing what we finished this week

blocks.say: Find the tickets finished this week.
Propose a ticket that lists them.

problems.message: Search Jira, Create a Jira ticket needs one input of kind jira_project, so the agent knows which project it may read. Add one.
Forge is an old name that confused the sponsor. Use plain words.
